task.description:
Execute the OIDC-08 test suite and produce a structured test report.

1. Run: zig build test (ensure all unit tests pass)
2. Run: zig build test-integration (requires BPM_TEST_DB_URL — run with env var set)
3. Run: zig build 2>&1 | grep -i "error set" (must produce no output)
4. Check test spec coverage: every test case in tests/specs/OIDC-08.md must have a corresponding passing test
5. Write test report to tests/reports/

If any compile-time errors occur (error-set mismatch, mutability, missing import, unused variable) affecting ≤2 files, fix inline. Otherwise route non-compile failures to ISSUE-FIXER.

All integration tests connect to real PostgreSQL via BPM_TEST_DB_URL.
acceptance_criteria: zig build test exits 0 — all unit tests pass
zig build test-integration exits 0 — all integration tests pass
All MUST acceptance criteria have passing test cases
